topics.purpose: Define explicit severity, category and recoverability metadata for errors without conflating operational severity with security classification or authorization.

semantics.severity_rule: Severity is operational impact evidence, not AccessCore/classification state.
semantics.security_rule: Security/privacy classification of error payload is separate metadata.
semantics.mapping_rule: Component-specific errors may map to shared categories through explicit mappings.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant definitions, executions, evidence and runtime state use explicit identities and boundaries; visibility, file order, timestamps, transport reachability or UI placement never silently create semantic authority.
